# The Last Watch Zombies — Server Quick Start

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-config-doc.py --quickstart. Defaults and names come from the source. -->

## First start

1. Install the same mod ZIP on the server **and** every client. Remove older `seventhnightzombies_*`, `thelastwatch_*` and `thelastwatchzombies_*` ZIPs, and back up your world first.
2. Start the server once. It creates `VintagestoryData/ModConfig/thelastwatchzombiesconfigmain.json` (gameplay) and `…configadvanced.json` (fine tuning — usually leave it alone).
3. Zombies spawn at night around Survival players. A horde arrives every 7th night. `/zombiehorde` shows when.

## Changing settings

* **In game (admins):** `/zombieconfig <name> <value>` — for example `/zombieconfig activecap 150`. The value is checked, saved to the config file and **takes effect immediately**. `/zombieconfig <name>` shows the current value; `/zombieconfig list` shows every name.
* **By file:** stop the server, edit the JSON file, start it again. Out-of-range values are corrected automatically on start.

## Most useful settings

### Spawning

| Setting | `/zombieconfig` name | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MaxActiveZombies` | `activecap` | 250 | Most zombies alive at once, server-wide (0 = no limit) |
| `zombiepopdailyaddlimit` | `ambientlimit` | 5 | New zombies per 96×96-block zone each night |
| `AmbientSpawnChancePerSecond` | `spawnchance` | 0.3 | Chance per second of a spawn attempt in each occupied zone |
| `SpawnMaxLightLevel` | `spawnlight` | 12 | Brightest light zombies may spawn in (0–31) |
| `ZombieSpawnNightOnly` | `strictnightonly` | on | Natural spawns only at night (18:00–06:00) |
| `DormantPopulationCap` | `dormantpopulationcap` | 250 | Most stored (dormant) zombies kept for later |
| `SpawnAlphaOnPlayerDeath` | `deathalpha` | on | An Alpha zombie appears near where a player died |
| `GrabberSpawnChance` | `grabberchance` | 0.04 | Chance a new zombie is a Grabber |
| `HiveSpawnChance` | `hivechance` | 0.02 | Chance of a Hive Zombie |
| `ScreamerSpawnChance` | `screamerchance` | 0.01 | Chance of a Screamer |
| `BloaterSpawnChance` | `bloaterchance` | 0.03 | Chance of a Bloater |

### Seventh-night hordes

| Setting | `/zombieconfig` name | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HordeEveryDays` | `hordedays` | 7 | A horde every N in-game days |
| `HordeDurationSeconds` | `hordeduration` | 600 | Horde length in real seconds |
| `HordeWaveIntervalSeconds` | `hordewaveinterval` | 180 | Real seconds between horde waves |
| `HordeWaveMaxZombiesPerPlayer` | `hordewavemax` | 5 | Most zombies per player per wave |

### Combat and sieges

| Setting | `/zombieconfig` name | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AttackDamage` | `attackdamage` | 2 | Damage per zombie hit (Alphas ×1.25) |
| `DetectionRange` | `detectionrange` | 32 | How far zombies notice prey, in blocks (32–128) |
| `BlockBreakingEnabled` | `blockbreaking` | on | Stuck zombies damage blocks in their way |
| `HordeBlockBreakChance` | `hordeblockbreakchance` | 0.9 | Chance per strike during hordes (0.65 otherwise) |
| `ProtectClaims` | `protectclaims` | on | Land claims are safe from zombie damage and spawning |
| `ProtectReinforcedBlocks` | `protectreinforced` | off | Reinforced blocks are fully immune (otherwise they wear down) |

### Infection and cure

| Setting | `/zombieconfig` name | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `InfectionFatalEnabled` | `fatality` | on | Untreated infection can kill |
| `InfectionFatalDays` | `fataldays` | 7 | In-game days until untreated infection kills |
| `CureStartWindowDays` | `curestartwindow` | 2 | In-game days to take the first cure dose |
| `NormalHitsToInfect` | `normalhits` | 4 | Bites from regular zombies (within 60 s) that infect |
| `AlphaHitsToInfect` | `alphahits` | 2 | Bites from Alpha zombies that infect |
| `CureDosesRequired` | `curedoses` | 6 | Mycobiotic Cure doses for a full cure |
| `CureDoseIntervalDays` | `doseinterval` | 1 | Minimum in-game days between doses |

### Loot and chat

| Setting | `/zombieconfig` name | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CorpseRustyGears` | `rustygears` | 1 | Rusty gears dropped per zombie corpse |
| `ZoneMigrationChatAnnouncement` | `migrationannounce` | on | Server-wide chat line when zombies migrate at sunset |

## Commands

**Everyone**

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/zombiehorde` | When the next horde comes, and how many zombies are active |
| `/zombieinfection` | Your infection details (also shown under Character > Traits) |

**Admins** (`controlserver` privilege or the server console)

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/zombieconfig list \| <name> \| <name> <value>` | List, show or change settings (applied immediately) |
| `/zombiepause, /zombieunpause` | Stop / resume all new zombie spawning (saved with the world) |
| `/zombiehordestart` | Start a horde now |
| `/zombiespawn <type>` | Spawn normal, alpha, grabber, hive, screamer or bloater next to you |
| `/snspawnstatus` | Explain why zombies are or are not spawning where you stand |
| `/snambienttest` | Try one real spawn and report why it failed |
| `/snambientreset` | Let your zone spawn its nightly zombies again (testing) |
| `/lastwatch` | Your zone: zombies, quotas, buildings, bonfires |
| `/zombiemap` | Toggle the zombie map overlay, then reopen the map (M) |
| `/zombiecycle` | Run the sunset migration now |
| `/snseed, /snseedneighbor` | Add 10 stored zombies to your zone / the zone east of you |
| `/zombieween` | Event: 5 stored zombies in every known zone, 2 cures per online player |
| `/zombiediagnostics on\|off, /zombieperf` | Performance counters |
| `/snspawn` | Spawn one random zombie next to you |

Every setting, with descriptions: `docs/CONFIGURATION.md` in the source repository, or `CONFIG-REFERENCE.md` in this ZIP for the defaults.
